archetypes.name: dyn-phase-a-routing
archetypes.rationale: Phase A now relies on combined stdout and exit-code routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architectural-guidelines prepare flow and SKILL.md routing together. Check that absent, invalid, present-ok, present-diff-failed, and invalidation-failed paths preserve the intended continue versus stop behavior. Pay close attention to stdout grammar and whether hard failures can still be misread as absent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-wrapper-retirement
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes two public wrapper files and replaces residual Bash registration.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the wrapper retirement and residual-bash path updates. Confirm no live prompt, script, or sibling-doc surface still directs callers to the retired read or materialize wrappers. Check that the new prepare wrapper preserves the previous forked-target resolution behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
